title: 🏆 Review: Units 1–4

activities.title: Review Story: Ready for the Quiz!

scenes.t: {name} meets Sam at school. 'Hello! How are you?' says Sam. 'I'm fine, thank you!'
Sam shows a photo of his family. 'This is my father. He is a doctor. This is my kind mother.'
At break time, they look at a map of Egypt. The Pyramids are in Giza. The library is next to the school.
'How do you feel?' asks Sam. {name} says, 'I feel happy today. Yesterday I felt tired.'
'We are ready for the big quiz!' says Sam. 'Let's do our best!'
{name} smiles. Reviewing is fun when we do it with friends!

items.q: We went on a school trip to the ___.
The girl is playing with ___ doll.
Fill: The ___ lives in a pond.
You can't find your bag. You feel…
You say 'please' and 'thank you'. You are…

activities.title: Writing: A Landmark I Visited
activities.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences about a landmark you visited in Egypt.
points: What did you see or do?
activities.note: Use capital letters, periods, and past tense verbs.
plan: I felt … It was a great day!
activities.punct: Capital letter at the start • period (.) at the end • question mark (?) for questions
model: Last summer, I visited the Pyramids of Giza.
First, we took photos. Then, we rode a camel.
I felt happy and excited. It was a great day!
check: I used past tense verbs (visited, went, saw)
I started each sentence with a capital letter
I ended each sentence with a period

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 63–66
